name: P2P Share
description: P2P Share lets a Jellyfin server operator share selected libraries with another Jellyfin server running the same plugin. Each share is an invite token with its own library selection, transcoding permission, bitrate cap, bandwidth limit and data quota. Shared libraries appear as regular libraries on the receiving server.
overview: Share libraries between Jellyfin servers with invite tokens

versions.changelog: Initial release: invite-token library sharing between Jellyfin 12 servers with per-share library selection, transcoding, bitrate/bandwidth caps, data quotas, concurrency limits, expiry and IP allowlists, plus global limits. Shared libraries appear as regular libraries on the receiving server.
